name: diversion-vscode
description: Source control integration for Diversion (https://www.diversion.dev) — register Diversion as a first-class SCM provider in VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Diversion runs the `dv` binary and sends a write-capable auth token to the configured CoreAPI endpoint. In untrusted workspaces the binary path and service URLs cannot be overridden by workspace settings.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Diversion requires a real filesystem and the local sync agent.

diversion.path.description: Path to the `dv` binary. Empty uses the system PATH lookup.

diversion.daemonUrl.description: Override the Diversion daemon URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:38825). Empty discovers via ~/.diversion/.port.

diversion.coreApiUrl.description: Override the Diversion CoreAPI base URL used for status, branches, log, and shelves. Empty uses the production endpoint (https://api.diversion.dev/v0).

diversion.refresh.debounceMs.description: Debounce window (in milliseconds) for the filesystem-watcher-driven SCM refresh. Editor-originated events (save, create, delete, rename) bypass this and refresh immediately; this only governs external file changes (build outputs, format-on-save tools, git or dv operations from another process).

diversion.maxParallelProcesses.description: Maximum number of `dv` CLI processes the extension will run concurrently. Higher values speed up bulk operations like loading commit data in the SCM Graph at the cost of more CPU and daemon load.

diversion.binaryExtensions.description: Additional file extensions (with leading dot, e.g. ".uplugin") to treat as binary on top of the built-in list. Binary files skip the side-by-side diff view and open directly.

diversion.scm.showAllRepoChanges.description: When opening a sub-directory of a Diversion repo, the SCM panel only shows changes inside the open folder(s) by default. Enable this to see ALL changes in the repo regardless of which folder you opened.

diversion.repositoryScanMaxDepth.description: How many directory levels below each workspace folder to scan for nested Diversion repositories (a `.diversion` folder). 0 disables nested scanning — only repositories containing the workspace folder itself are detected. Default 1 finds repos that are direct children of the workspace folder, matching the built-in git extension's `git.repositoryScanMaxDepth`.

diversion.clashDetection.description: Flag files that teammates are already editing, with a badge in the explorer and a one-time warning when you start editing one. Advisory only — unlike `dv lock` it prevents nothing and needs no paid tier. Costs one cloud request per repo per minute, made only for repos you are actually looking at.

diversion.log.level.description: Verbosity of the Diversion output channel.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the current Diversion SCM state of a repository: branch, commit ID, sync state (paused / read-only), and the list of working-tree changes (modified/added/deleted/renamed files) plus any sync conflicts. Use this when you need to know what files the user has changed in their Diversion workspace, or what branch/commit they are on. Diversion is a different VCS than git; do NOT use git tools on Diversion repos.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show the current Diversion working-tree status, branch, and commit.

repo.description: Optional. Repository name (e.g. 'MyProject') or an absolute filesystem path inside the repo. Required if multiple Diversion repos are open in the workspace; omit when there is only one.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the unified diff of the current working tree against the base commit, optionally scoped to specific paths. Use this when you need to see WHAT the user changed (the actual hunks) — for code review, generating a commit message, or explaining their work. Returns plain text in standard unified diff format.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show the unified diff of working-tree changes in a Diversion repo.

repo.description: Optional. Repository name or absolute path inside the repo.

paths.description: Optional list of repo-relative file or directory paths to scope the diff to. Omit to diff the entire working tree.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_diff_refs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the unified diff between two refs (commits, branches, or tags). Use this to compare branches or see what changed between two commits.

repo.description: Optional. Repository name or absolute path inside the repo.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_log
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns recent commits in the current branch with full message bodies, author, date, and any branch refs at each commit. Use this for history queries, changelog generation, or to find a specific past change. Supports `since` / `until` filters (ISO or relative date like '1 week ago').
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show recent commits in a Diversion repo.

since.description: ISO date or relative ('1 week ago').

languageModelTools.name: diversion_file_history
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns commits that touched a specific file or directory. Equivalent to `git log -- <path>`. Use this when the user asks 'who changed file X', 'when was Y last modified', or wants the history of a single file. Set includeSquashed to also surface commits that merges squashed away, which is how you recover a file's history from before a merge, with the original author and message.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show the commit history of a specific file or directory.

includeSquashed.description: Also report commits that merges squashed away. Slower — it shells out to dv.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_overlapping_commits
languageModelTools.displayName: Diversion: Commits Touching My Dirty Paths
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns recent commits on the current branch that touched the SAME paths the user has uncommitted working-tree changes in. This is the 'what might conflict with my work' awareness signal — use it before committing or before suggesting a merge to surface where the user's changes overlap with other recent activity.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find recent commits that overlap with my working-tree changes.

lookback.description: How many recent commits to scan. Default 50.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_show
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns full details for a single commit: author, date, message, refs, and the list of files it changed.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show details for a Diversion commit.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_branches
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns all branches in the Diversion repository with their tip commit IDs. The currently checked-out branch is marked with a leading '*'. Use this when the user asks about branches, wants to switch branches, or you need to know which branch a commit is on.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List branches in a Diversion repo.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_list_tags
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists every tag in the repo with its commit pointer and description. Backed by `dv tag --json` for stable structured output.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List tags in a Diversion repo.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_list_cloud_repos
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists repositories the authenticated dv account has access to, partitioned into locally-cloned vs remote-only. Useful for discovery before cloning a new repo.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List repos accessible to my Diversion account.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_shelves
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists every shelf saved in the Diversion repository with its description / metadata.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List shelves in a Diversion repo.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_show_shelf
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Shows the changes contained in a single shelf (raw dv output).

languageModelTools.name: diversion_locks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists every hard lock visible to the workspace, with holder if known. Use this before editing binary assets that may be exclusively locked.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List active locks in a Diversion repo.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_annotate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns per-line attribution (commit / author / date) for a single text file in the workspace. Equivalent to git blame.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show per-line blame for a file.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_commit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Commits working-tree changes in a Diversion repo. Pass `paths` to commit a subset; omit for everything. The commit message is required. Diversion auto-syncs after a successful commit.

paths.description: Optional repo-relative paths to scope the commit to. Omit for all changes.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_create_branch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new Diversion branch from the current branch. By default switches to the new branch.

switchTo.description: Switch to the new branch (default true).

languageModelTools.name: diversion_delete_branch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a branch (by name or ID). The default branch cannot be deleted.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_rename_branch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames an existing branch.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_checkout
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Checks out a branch, tag, or commit. Set takeChanges / shelveChanges / discardChanges to control what happens to uncommitted working-tree changes (only one may be true). Shelved changes on the target branch stay shelved unless applyShelf is true.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check out a ref in a Diversion repo.

ref.description: Branch name, tag, or commit ID.

applyShelf.description: Un-shelve the target branch's shelved changes after checkout.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_merge
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Merges the given ref into the currently checked-out branch. On conflicts the merge is parked server-side rather than failing, and the result says so. The conflict strategy here is keep-destination, not keep-current as in diversion_revert_commit.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Merge a ref into the current branch.

conflictResolution.description: How to resolve conflicts. Default manual parks the merge for the Diversion app.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_open_merges
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists merges parked on conflicts, awaiting per-block resolution in the Diversion app. Distinct from .dv-conflict sidecar files, which are sync conflicts on disk and show up in diversion_status.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List unresolved merges in a Diversion repo.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_cherry_pick
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Applies the changes of a single past commit on top of the current branch.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_revert_commit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new commit that inverts the changes of a past commit. Does not rewrite history.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_revert_to_commit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sets the workspace contents to match a given commit. Does NOT rewrite history; creates a new commit reflecting the rolled-back state.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Restore the workspace to a past commit.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_restore_path
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Overwrites a single file in the working tree with its contents from a given ref.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Restore a file from a Diversion ref.

ref.description: Ref to source the file from.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_discard_path
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Discards uncommitted changes to a single workspace-relative path.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_discard_all
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Discards every uncommitted change in the workspace. If includeNew is true, also removes newly-added (untracked) files.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_create_tag
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a tag at a specific commit, or at the current commit if `commit` is omitted.

commit.description: Commit to tag (defaults to current commit).

languageModelTools.name: diversion_modify_tag
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames a tag and/or replaces its description. Keyed on the tag ID (dv.tag.<n>) from diversion_list_tags, NOT the tag name. Pass at least one of name / description.

description.description: New tag description. Pass "" to clear.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_delete_tag
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a tag. Keyed on the tag ID (dv.tag.<n>) from diversion_list_tags, NOT the tag name.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_create_shelf
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Shelves working-tree changes under a name. If `paths` is supplied only those are shelved; otherwise all changes. Set keepWorkingChanges to keep the working tree intact.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_apply_shelf
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Applies a shelved changeset on top of the working tree.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_delete_shelf
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a shelf permanently.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_rename_shelf
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames an existing shelf.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_lock_path
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Acquires a hard lock on a path so other users cannot modify it. Requires a Studio or Enterprise subscription on the repo.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Lock a file in a Diversion repo.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_unlock_path
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Releases a hard lock previously acquired on a path.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Unlock a file in a Diversion repo.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_pause_sync
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Pauses the agent's background sync for the workspace (like working offline).

languageModelTools.name: diversion_resume_sync
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resumes the agent's background sync for the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_update_workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Force-pulls the workspace's base branch. Useful when auto-update is off or you want to update immediately.

languageModelTools.name: diversion_verify
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs dv's built-in integrity verification on the repo and returns the output.
